## What

Describe the resulting behavior.

## Why

Describe the problem or supported task.

## Tests

Record meaningful checks and any remaining execution gaps.

## Checklist

- [ ] A meaningful regression test covers changed behavior, where applicable
- [ ] Package/generated checks, relevant tests and packed-install checks pass
- [ ] All runnable examples match their documented output
- [ ] Optional renderer checks pass when rendering/browser behavior changes; skipped or unavailable checks are identified
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` covers user-visible changes, where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, private data, raw execution logs or links to files that do not ship
- [ ] Third-party notices and team-owned context/customizations remain intact
